summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of 58:12 Global Connect Uganda CRM - All NEW features tested and working: Store Settings per location, Sales Import/Export, Outreach sessions, Admin multi-location editing, Products CRUD with location, POS checkout flow, Audit Trail with bulk delete, App Settings, Financial Management
seed_data_creation: Test products, sales, and outreach sessions created during testing (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All NEW features from iteration 26 are working: 1) Store Settings per location (GET/PUT /api/store-settings/{loc_id}) - modal shows payment methods, tax rate, currency, receipt footer. 2) Sales Import/Export (GET /api/sales/export, POST /api/sales/import) - modal with export button and import textarea. 3) Outreach sessions - page shows programmes and sessions tabs. 4) Admin multi-location - New User modal has location dropdown, department dropdown, role dropdown, system admin toggle. 5) Products CRUD with location field - Add Product modal has location dropdown. 6) POS checkout - cart, payment method selection, receipt modal. 7) Audit Trail - 326 events, 99 items in recycle bin with bulk select/delete. 8) App Settings - branding, currency, contact info sections. 9) Financial Management - summary cards, cashflow chart, donations/expenses/approvals tabs, location filter.

login_dashboard.details: Login with admin@5812uganda.org / Admin@5812 works, dashboard shows stats (15 members, 73 families, 4 check-ins, 3 events, UGX 230,000 donations, UGX 1,052,000 expenses)

sales_products_page.details: Location filter dropdown works, POS tab shows products, search works, 7 products displayed

products_crud.details: Add Product with location field works, edit product works, delete product works

pos_checkout.details: Add items to cart, customer name input, payment method selection (Cash, Mobile Money, Card), Complete Sale generates receipt with invoice number

import_export.details: Export Sales (JSON) button works, Import Sales textarea accepts JSON format

store_settings.details: Store Settings button appears when location selected, modal shows store name, payment methods checkboxes, mobile money providers, tax rate, currency, receipt footer

sales_history.details: Shows 4 sales with Invoice, Customer, Items, Total, Payment, Location, Date, Cashier columns

customers_tab.details: Customer Directory shows 4 customers with Total Spent, Transactions, Last Purchase

staff_management.details: 5 staff members displayed, New User modal has location dropdown, department dropdown, role dropdown, system admin toggle

outreach_page.details: Programmes & Outreach page shows stats (0 Active, 4 Sessions, 0 Reached), Programmes and Sessions tabs, New Programme button

app_settings.details: Branding section (app name, footer, logo URL), Currency section (default UGX, main location USD), Contact Information section, Save Settings button

audit_trail.details: 326 events in Audit Log tab, 99 items in Recycle Bin with type filter, Select All checkbox, Restore/Delete buttons

financial_page.details: Summary cards (donations, expenses, sales, net balance), location filter, cashflow chart, Donations/Expenses/Approvals tabs
